Usage: newlangc [--version | --help | SOURCE]

       newlangc --experimental-c17-u8-export FUNCTION SOURCE
NewLang production compiler P0 bootstrap.
  --version  Print the deterministic compiler version.
  --help     Print this help.
  --check SOURCE  Validate source without backend emission.
  SOURCE          Emit supported checked-profile C17 to stdout.
  --emit-c17-to OUTPUT SOURCE
             Stage and replace a named C17 file (POSIX local host).
  --experimental-c17-u8-export FUNCTION SOURCE
             Experimental Copy-only u8 export with a fixed C17 header;
             not general FFI.
